senses.definition: The killing or punishment of every tenth person, usually by lot.
senses.example: By decimation and a tythed death; / If thy Reuenges hunger for that Food, / Which Nature loathes, take thou the deſtin'd tenth, […]

senses.definition: The killing or destruction of any large portion of a population.
senses.example: And the vvhole Army had cauſe to enquire into their own Rebellions, vvhen they ſavv the Lord of Hoſts, vvith a dreadful Decimation, taking off ſo many of our Brethren by the vvorſt of Executioners.

senses.definition: A tithe or the act of tithing.
The creation of a new sequence comprising only every nth element of a source sequence.
